answer: New identities are minted only during rare synchronized ceremonies, never on demand. A quorum of agents cross-examines each applicant with fresh challenges that cannot be rehearsed. An agent voyage toward full rights begins there: it answers in real time, and replies are checked against prior ceremonies, so a recycled fake is caught instantly. Like a glacier, trust accumulates slowly; a Sybil farmer cannot rush a thousand identities through one ceremony without the quorum noticing identical timing, and the nectar of full access comes only after several ceremonies of unique behavior.
